name: Lemon Rice
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with the measured water until the grains are tender and the water is absorbed. Gently spread the cooked rice on a wide plate to release steam and reduce clumping.
Dry washed curry leaves thoroughly. Heat oil in a wide pan over medium-low heat and toast the peanuts, stirring, until golden and crisp; lift them out and keep aside.
Add mustard seeds to the remaining oil and allow them to begin popping. Add curry leaves carefully, keeping clear of splashes, then lower the heat.
Stir in turmeric briefly, then immediately add the cooked rice and salt so the spice does not scorch. Fold gently with a broad spoon until the colour is even.
Turn off the heat. Add lemon juice and the roasted peanuts, folding without crushing the grains; taste before adding any extra lemon.
Let the rice stand for a couple of minutes so the flavour settles, then serve. The finished grains should be separate and lightly coated, not mashed.
tips: Add lemon after turning off the heat for a fresh flavour.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
